title: Silva Insights onboard regression dossier
content:
Purpose:
This dossier captures the onboarding acceptance criteria, pinned prompt candidates, private dataset summary, and regression test plan for Silva Insights (customer) model onboarding. Working doc: contains TODOs, rough numbers, and items for legal/CS signoff. Goal: create a lightweight but executable acceptance gate that product + CS can run before provisioning Dedicated capacity.

High-level summary:
- Customer: Silva Insights (financial analytics SaaS)
- Use case: automated earnings call summarization + sentiment tagging + action-item extraction for enterprise intelligence.
- Data constraints: customer will supply private transcripts and annotated action-item labels; data cannot leave their VPC during Private deployment (we will run evaluation via secure transfer process / ephemeral instance per agreement).
- Candidate model family: open-arch transformer (base 13B -> quantized 4-bit variants) and a tuned 7B variant for latency-sensitive routes.

Private datasets (verbatim notes):
- silva-transcripts-2023-2025-v2 (S3, redwood-ephemeral access): ~12k transcripts, avg length 1200 tokens, speaker-separated. Labels: highlight spans for action-items, sentiment per paragraph (pos/neu/neg), speaker role tagging (analyst/exec). Transfer via customer-approved pipeline.
- silva-annotations-audit.csv: human QA of 1.2k panels (overlap annotator agreement kappa=0.72).
- synthetic-augmentation: small set of 600 synthetic Q/A pairs to stress polite/ironic language.

Pinned prompt candidates (aim: reproducibility + regression stability):
1) Summary (concise):
"You are an unbiased assistant. Summarize the key points of the following earnings call transcript in 4 bullet points. Keep named entities intact and label any forward-looking statements. Transcript:
<<TRANSCRIPT>>"

2) Action-item extraction (structured):
"From the transcript below, extract action-items as JSON array of {assignee, action, due_date_if_mentioned}. If a due date is not present, set due_date:null. Return only valid JSON. Transcript:
<<TRANSCRIPT>>"

3) Sentiment tagging (per-paragraph):
"Tag each paragraph with sentiment: POSITIVE, NEUTRAL, NEGATIVE. Return as newline-delimited pairs: PARAGRAPH_INDEX \t SENTIMENT. Transcript:
<<TRANSCRIPT>>"

Prompt variants to include in regression: short/long transcript, misaligned speaker labels, obfuscated entity names. Include negative tests: garbled input, multi-lingual interjections, overlapping speaker segments.

Acceptance criteria (hard gates and advisory metrics):
- Accuracy (action-item extraction): F1 >= 0.78 on customer holdout set (silva-annotations-audit.csv). This is a hard gate.
- Sentiment tagging: macro F1 >= 0.72 (hard gate).
- Named entities preserved in summaries: ratio_preserved >= 0.95 (advisory; require signoff if below 0.9).
- Summary factuality (proxy): hallucination rate <= 0.06 measured by pairwise QA check on 600 sampled bullets (advisory but must be <=0.10 to proceed).
- Latency: p95 <= 1.1s per 128-token decode on Dedicated 1xA100-equivalent for the tuned 7B route (hard gate for latency-sensitive route).
- Cost: token-cost per 1k output tokens <= $0.XX (internal estimate; advisory).
- Robustness: pass 95% of the negative-case tests (case suite below) or escalate to applied-ml owner.

Regression test suite (execution plan):
- Dataset split: use silva-transcripts-holdout-1000 for continuous regression (kept immutable).
- Test runner: existing rhino-eval harness (ref PR link above) with instrumented metrics for token usage, latency, and output diffs.
- Nightly CI: run subset (200 random transcripts) plus all negative-case tests; report to Slack #silva-onboard with CSV of metrics.
- Weekly full suite: run full 1000-case holdout and generate signoff report.
- Regression alerting: if F1 delta vs baseline > 0.03 or latency p95 increases by >20%, generate-blocker ticket and auto-snapshot outputs for debugging.

Negative-case test list (quick):
- Garbled text insertions (unicode noise)
- Code-switching with Spanish phrases (customer has latin-american calls occasionally)
- Missing speaker labels (collapsed speakers)
- Overlapping speaker timestamps (simulate VAD errors)
- Extremely long monologues (>> 5000 tokens)
- Entity masking (XXX for PII)

Sign-off checklist (who signs what):
- Applied ML owner (Ava Martinez): verify metrics & regression artifacts attached.
- Solutions Engineer (Ravi Patel): verify integration harness and deployment configs.
- Customer Success (Maya Chen): verify acceptance criteria match contract.
- Security/Compliance (Liam O'Connor): verify data transfer plan and ephemeral host controls.
- Product manager (to be assigned): approve rollout window and SLA mapping.

Rollout and fallback plan:
- Canary: 5% traffic to tuned-7B route (low-latency), 95% to 13B for highest-quality. Monitor quality metrics closely.
- Fallback: automatic routing to 13B if 7B latency p95 >1.1s or action-item F1 drops >0.05 vs baseline.
- Circuit-breaker: abort if any hard gate violation occurs in canary or if negative-case pass rate falls < 90%.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Confirm cost-per-token budget number with pricing team (TODO: tag pricing).
- Need legal signoff for ephemeral evaluation runner pattern (ticket to Legal).
- Decide which quantized kernel to standardize on for Dedicated (ampere-optimized vs fallback). Jun to benchmark by 2026-01-18.
- Annotator disagreement cases: sample 200 ambiguous items and run consensus exercise.

Artifacts to attach for signoff package:
- CSV: holdout-1000-eval-results.csv (per-case JSON outputs + metrics)
- CI: nightly-summary-YYYY-MM-DD.csv (examples)
- Notebook: manual-review-samples.ipynb (10 positive/10 failure cases)
- Deployment config: silva-routing-policy.yaml (canary + fallback thresholds)

Last notes (informal):
- Customer emphasized "no summary edits by humans" rule for initial rollout — they want raw model outputs for audit. Keep that in docs.
- Early run showed tendency to collapse multi-step action items into a single line; add combined-action splitting heuristic to post-process or include in prompt (experiment A/B).
- Annotators flagged sarcasm-heavy analyst remarks as NEG incorrectly; will add targeted synthetic examples.

Sign-off history (placeholder):
- 2026-02-28: draft ready for eng-ml and CS review.

-- END OF DOSSIER --
